NAME: Memories (ISRAM boot ROM DSRAM) verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-MEM-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 64 KiB instruction memory at ISRAM_BASE readable by the ...
details: 64 KiB instruction memory at ISRAM_BASE, readable by the instruction port.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_isram_rw
details: Oracle: write/read every word via D-port Coverage goal: all 4 banks-equivalent ranges
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, checks 'ISRAM write -> immediate read', [N-7.2] aliasing, random soak 4 x 200 vs shadow model - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Not an exhaustive every-word walk.

NAME: t_isram_fetch
details: Oracle: execute from ISRAM via I-port
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/chip/t_chip_basic.c, t_chip_irq.c, t_chip_wdt.c, t_chip_jtag.c: every chip program executes from ISRAM through the I-port; not in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 ISRAM shall be writable by the data port and by Debug SBA so that ...
details: ISRAM shall be writable by the data port and by Debug SBA, so that boot and JTAG can load it.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0005

NAME: t_isram_dport_write
details: Oracle: D-port write lands; the Rev 1.2 failure is gone
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, check 'ISRAM write -> immediate read (buffer bypass)' - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Chip-level: sw/chip/t_chip_basic.c step 5 (ISRAM writable) RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: t_isram_sba_write
details: Oracle: SBA write lands
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, check [N-7.9] SBA write bypasses ILOCK - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Also tb/debug/tb_debug.sv ISRAM SBA load.

NAME: R-3 ISRAM shall be write-protectable after boot so flight code cannot ...
details: ISRAM shall be write-protectable after boot, so flight code cannot corrupt its own instructions.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0006

NAME: t_ilock
details: Oracle: set, then writes ERROR, reads pass, SBA passes Coverage goal: all 4 combinations of {locked,unlocked}×{sba,not}
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, checks [N-7.8] write refused with ILOCK set, [N-7.10] read unaffected, [N-7.9] SBA bypass - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Chip-level: sw/chip/t_chip_basic.c steps 6 and 7 RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: t_ilock_sticky
details: Oracle: no software clear succeeds; reset clears
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, checks 'MEMCTL.ILOCK not cleared by writing 0' and 'ILOCK cleared by SWRST' - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression; the check lives in the reset-controller bench, not in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv.

NAME: R-4 4 KiB read-only Boot ROM at BOOTROM_BASE containing the reset ...
details: 4 KiB read-only Boot ROM at BOOTROM_BASE, containing the reset vector.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_rom_read
details: Oracle: every ROM word readable; writes ERROR
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, checks 'Boot ROM word read', halfword read legal, 'Boot ROM write -> ERROR', 'contents unchanged' - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Not every ROM word.

NAME: R-5 64 KiB data memory at DSRAM_BASE contiguous as a single AHB slave.
details: 64 KiB data memory at DSRAM_BASE, contiguous, as a single AHB slave.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0007

NAME: t_dsram_contiguous
details: Oracle: walk all 64 KiB across bank boundaries Coverage goal: all 3 boundaries
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, checks 'DSRAM banks 1/2/3 by haddr[15:14]' and 'each word landed in the bank its address selects' - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Not a full 64 KiB walk.

NAME: R-6 All three shall be zero-wait-state at 250 MHz.
details: All three shall be zero-wait-state at 250 MHz.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_zero_wait
details: Oracle: hreadyout never low, back-to-back transfers
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, check [N-7.6] zero wait states on every legal access - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 The bootloader shall copy firmware from SPI flash to ISRAM ...
details: The bootloader shall copy firmware from SPI flash to ISRAM without using the DMA.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0015

NAME: t_boot_pio
details: Oracle: full boot from a modelled SPI flash
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/chip/t_chip_flash.c with +MODE=flash (Boot ROM copies the image from modelled SPI flash by programmed I/O and jumps; main() reached); log sim/chip_flash, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-8 The bootloader shall copy the .data initialisation image to DSRAM.
details: The bootloader shall copy the .data initialisation image to DSRAM.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0015

NAME: t_boot_data_copy
details: Oracle: .data present in DSRAM at entry
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/chip/t_chip_flash.c step 3 (g_data = 0xC0FFEE01 and .bss zero after boot); log sim/chip_flash, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-9 The bootloader shall verify the image with CRC-32 before ...
details: The bootloader shall verify the image with CRC-32 before executing it.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0016

NAME: t_boot_crc_pass
details: Oracle: correct image boots
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/chip/t_chip_flash.c (a correct image boots; reaching main() means the CRC matched); log sim/chip_flash, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_boot_crc_fail
details: Oracle: single-bit corruption is caught Coverage goal: bit flips in text and data images
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, sw/chip/t_chip_flash.c, tb/soc/tb_chip.sv (no corrupted-image mode).

NAME: R-10 A verification failure shall leave the chip recoverable over JTAG ...
details: A verification failure shall leave the chip recoverable over JTAG, not halted.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0016

NAME: t_boot_recovery
details: Oracle: CRC fail → spin, ILOCK clear, SBA load works, release runs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, sw/chip/*.c, tb/soc/tb_chip.sv (recovery mailbox is used as the entry for chip tests, but no CRC-fail then spin then SBA load then release sequence).

NAME: R-11 A boot_sel pin shall select JTAG load instead of flash boot.
details: A boot_sel pin shall select JTAG load instead of flash boot.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0014

NAME: t_boot_sel
details: Oracle: boot_sel=1 skips flash entirely
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/chip/t_chip_basic.c step 2 (CLKSTAT boot_sel) and every +MODE=basic/irq/wdt/jtag run entering through the boot_sel=1 mailbox; no explicit check that flash is untouched, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_boot_blank_flash
details: Oracle: erased flash (0xFFFFFFFF) takes recovery
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, sw/chip/*.c, tb/soc/tb_chip.sv.

NAME: R-12 The design shall assume SRAM macros with no sleep retention or ...
details: The design shall assume SRAM macros with no sleep, retention or ECC pins.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0021

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_mem_sizes
details: Oracle: all 7 legal size/offset combinations Coverage goal: all 7
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, checks 'byte + half lanes merge', 'Boot ROM halfword read is legal [N-7.5]', [N-7.4] misaligned word/half gives ERROR - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. The 7 size/offset combinations are not enumerated in the log.

NAME: t_boot_trap
details: Oracle: an exception during boot reaches recovery
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv, sw/chip/*.c, tb/soc/tb_chip.sv.

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_isram_zero_wait
details: zero wait states: hreadyout is never deasserted
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv ([N-7.6] zero wait states on every legal access).

NAME: a_dsram_zero_wait
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv ([N-7.6] zero wait states on every legal access).

NAME: a_ilock_blocks_write
details: ILOCK: no write reaches the macro while locked, unless SBA
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv ([N-7.8] ISRAM write refused with ILOCK set).

NAME: a_ilock_error
details: ILOCK: a locked write gets a two-cycle ERROR
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv ([N-7.8] write refused; ERROR response).

NAME: a_sba_bypass
details: ILOCK: SBA writes are never blocked
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv ([N-7.9] SBA write bypasses ILOCK).

NAME: a_ilock_sticky
details: ILOCK is sticky: never falls except at reset
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (MEMCTL.ILOCK not cleared by writing 0; cleared by SWRST); not in tb_mem_subsystem.sv.

NAME: a_ilock_reads_ok
details: reads are never blocked by the lock
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv ([N-7.10] ISRAM read unaffected).

NAME: a_rom_write_error
details: Boot ROM rejects every write
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv (Boot ROM write -> ERROR).

NAME: a_be_correct
details: byte enables match hsize and address
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv (byte + half lanes merge).

NAME: a_dsram_onehot_we
details: DSRAM: exactly one bank write-enabled per write
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv (each word landed in the bank its address selects).

NAME: a_dsram_rmux
details: DSRAM read mux matches the bank decode
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv (DSRAM banks 1/2/3 by haddr[15:14]).

NAME: a_misaligned_error
details: misaligned backstop
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/mem/tb_mem_subsystem.sv ([N-7.4] misaligned word/half gives ERROR).
